input.query: WITH fits AS (SELECT channel, activation_month, regr_slope(ln(retention), months_since_activation) AS slope, count(*) AS n FROM agg_retention_cohorts WHERE months_since_activation BETWEEN 3 AND 24 AND cohort_size >= 200 AND retention > 0 GROUP BY channel, activation_month HAVING count(*) >= 6) SELECT channel, count(*) AS eligible_cohorts, median(1-exp(slope)) AS median_cohort_monthly_churn, min(1-exp(slope)) AS min_cohort_monthly_churn, max(1-exp(slope)) AS max_cohort_monthly_churn FROM fits GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel
